parameters.content:
## I.MCIN — marketing invoices → LP-MCP (thin transport ONLY)

Gmail (`to:marketing-invoices@reecewindowsmail.com`) → every pdf / png / jpg / tif / heic / csv / xlsx attachment, or the email body when there is none → POST base64 JSON → LP-MCP `/n8n/admin/marketing-invoice-ingest`.

ZERO parsing here (handoff 2026-10-12 §7.1, §14). LP-MCP dedupes on the file hash, stores the original in the private `marketing-invoices` bucket, gets the TEXT for free from reece-speech-api `/v1/extract` (pdfplumber + Tesseract — no paid model ever sees the file), reads it with rules then the model, builds the ledger rows and posts the review card to #marketing-invoice-review. Only Mark or Brad Codman can approve there.

**The trigger is scoped by `to:`.** It never sees the LP report mail on this mailbox, and `I.LPRA`–`I.LPRG` never see invoices. Do not remove the scoping (README-lp-report-ingest.md, "Do not remove that scoping").

**The body is JSON with base64**, not multipart: one request per attachment, `{gmail_message_id, from, subject, received_at, file_name, mime_type, file_b64}`; `file_b64:null` + `body_text` for an email with no attachment.

**Failure handling.** A 200 with `success:false` is a deterministic rejection, never retried. A 5xx is retried 3×, then `/events/marketing_invoice_ingest_failed`. A re-poll of the same message answers `duplicate:true` and is a success.

**Both outcomes report**, like I.LPRE since 2026-08-29.

**Secret.** `x-ghl-signature` = the same `LP_REPORT_INGEST_SECRET` the LP report workflows send (the live I.LPRE carries it as a literal; this export uses `$env.LP_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE` — paste the value on import if the env var is not set).

**Import INACTIVE, send one test email, then activate** (handoff §13.4).
